entities.summary: Anthony Frederick Augustus Sandys, 1 May 1829 – 25 June 1904, usually known as Frederick Sandys, was a British painter, illustrator, and draughtsman, associated with the Pre-Raphaelites. He was also associated with the Norwich School of painters. Frederick Sandys was a painters & sculptors from Norwich (1829-05-01, Norwich–1904-06-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
